text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in the mean absolute error of the median between two arms (points of the substation's capacity; more negative means the first arm is better). N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5 weather from September 2023, without lagged power. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 99% interval, widened for the five planned contrasts. Solid rule: no difference.'
text.tspan: Change in the mean absolute error of the median between two arms (points of the substation's
capacity; more negative means the first arm is better).
N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with
lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5
weather from September 2023, without lagged power.
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: estimate. Line: 99% interval, widened for the five planned contrasts. Solid rule: no
